# dragonruby-vfx

> Visual effects for the DragonRuby Game Toolkit (Ruby, mruby runtime). One file per effect in mygame/lib/vfx/, no dependencies between files, MIT licence.

Conventions shared by every effect:
- `Vfx::<Effect>.new(...)` returns a plain Hash of state. Keep it in `args.state`.
- Trigger functions (`add`, `freeze`, `flash`, `squash`, ...) take that Hash first.
- `Vfx::<Effect>.tick(state)` is called once per frame (60 per second). `Vfx::Shake`, `Vfx::Squash`, `Vfx::Particles`, `Vfx::DamageNumbers` and `Vfx::Weather` take a second argument, the time scale (0 holds them still); freeze the others by not calling `tick`.
- Results are read from the Hash or from a helper (`apply`, `sprite`, `sprites`, `overlay`) that returns sprite Hashes for `args.outputs.primitives`.
- Helpers named `draw(outputs, ...)` fill a render target and return the one sprite that shows it; pass `args.outputs`.
- Stateless effects (`Vfx::RgbSplit`, `Vfx::Pixelate`, `Vfx::Film`, `Vfx::Lights`, `Vfx::Silhouette`, `Vfx::Lightning`, `Vfx::Parallax`, `Vfx::Slices`, `Vfx::Warp`, `Vfx::Shadows`) have no `new` and no `tick`.
- A triangle is a sprite Hash with `x, y, x2, y2, x3, y3` in place of `w, h`, and `source_x, source_y, source_x2, ...` for the part of the picture it shows.
- Blend modes on a sprite Hash: `blendmode: 1` normal, `2` additive, `8` multiply.
- Sprites are Hashes with `x, y, w, h, path`; `x, y` is the bottom-left corner. `path: :solid` is a filled rectangle.
- Code must run on mruby: no Regexp, and `Integer#/` may return a Float.

## Effects

- [Trauma screen shake](docs/effects/shake.md): `mygame/lib/vfx/shake.rb`, `Vfx::Shake`
- [Hit stop](docs/effects/hit_stop.md): `mygame/lib/vfx/hit_stop.rb`, `Vfx::HitStop`
- [Camera flash, fade, punch, kick](docs/effects/camera_fx.md): `mygame/lib/vfx/camera_fx.rb`, `Vfx::CameraFx`

- [Particles](docs/effects/particles.md): `mygame/lib/vfx/particles.rb`, `Vfx::Particles`

- [Light map](docs/effects/lights.md): `mygame/lib/vfx/lights.rb`, `Vfx::Lights`

- [RGB split](docs/effects/rgb_split.md): `mygame/lib/vfx/rgb_split.rb`, `Vfx::RgbSplit`

- [Lightning](docs/effects/lightning.md): `mygame/lib/vfx/lightning.rb`, `Vfx::Lightning`
